decision: Preserve v7.6.4 audit v7.7.0 contract v7.7.1 harness and v7.7.2 execution as immutable sources
Require v7.7.2 status LONG_RANGE_TASK_VALIDITY_PASS with gpu_used false and grassmann_fitted false as the only valid source
Treat task validity as a synthetic mechanism property and not a Grassmann or biological success
Fix the complete 2x2 factorial crossing Grassmann presence with shared global router presence
Define the shared global router as a full-sequence conventional model not handed the source positions
Require the router implementation receptive field inputs schedule and data identical across router-present arms
Use NLL(LR_A01) minus NLL(LR_A11) as the primary router-conditional incremental Grassmann contrast
Require paired one-sided 95 percent LCB strictly above 0.010 nats per target plus validity shuffled and fairness for future GO
Treat Grassmann main effect and Grassmann-by-router interaction as secondary estimands that cannot override the primary
Forbid matched-parameter and matched-compute labels until a non-identity and a realized-compute audit pass
Use synthetic truth seed as the repeat unit and average nested initialization seeds within it
Freeze the formal truth-seed count only from a blinded CPU planning-only variance pilot that withholds arm means
Bar all pilot data from the formal analysis and forbid result-dependent design selection
Close the v7 Grassmann-primary route if a precise preregistered comparison shows no practical benefit
Forbid GPU Grassmann training A3 HAPNEST HGDP phenotype and biological long-range claims in this release
Authorize only implementing the v7.7.4 CPU blinded variance pilot without GPU
